raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On Intel XPU (CRI), diffusion ring attention (`--ring-degree N`) runs torch's templated ring over BF16 flash attention. It is slow, and under `torch.compile` it hangs. DeepSymm (`applications.ai.gpu.deepsymm`) has an IPC ring for CRI. It moves K/V over the copy engine, overlaps the transfer with compute, and runs attention in bf16, fp8, fp8_mixed or mxfp4.

## Modifications

- New `backends/xpu_deepsymm_ring.py`: loads `deep_symm.ring_attn` and checks which layers the kernel supports: non-causal self-attention, head size 64/128, default softmax scale. MX/FP8 precisions need MHA with head size 128. Layers that only satisfy the base checks run at bf16, and the others keep the torch ring.
- `USPAttention` ring branch: routes to DeepSymm when `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_DEEPSYMM_RING_PRECISION` is set to `bf16` / `fp8` / `fp8_mixed` / `mxfp4`. The default `off` keeps current behaviour. The check runs only for XPU tensors, so other platforms see no change and no graph break.
- `destroy_model_parallel` releases the ring's IPC cache.
- Unit test: per-layer precision rules, plus a 2-rank ring vs full attention for every precision.

## Accuracy Tests

The 2-rank ring vs an fp32 full-sequence reference (rel L2): bf16 0.0026, fp8 0.054, fp8_mixed 0.172, mxfp4 0.288.

Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 1280x720x81 with `mxfp4` on every block: the video keeps the scene and motion, but shows a fine-grained (grainy) high-frequency texture. With `bf16` it is clean. Keeping a few sensitive blocks (0, 33, 34, 38) at bf16 gives a clean video at near-mxfp4 speed. That needs a per-block override, which #48059's BF16 block list provides for the Sage V3 path, so this PR does not include one.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 1280x720x81, 40 steps, 2 Intel CRI cards at 2500 MHz, cache off, DeepSymm `8cf4100`.

| Setup | End to end |
|---|---|
| This PR, compiled, `mxfp4` | 498.4 s |
| This PR, compiled, `bf16` | 1755.8 s |
| With #48059 and #48060 (MXFP8 GEMMs), eager, torch ring | 902.9 s |
| With #48059 and #48060 (MXFP8 GEMMs), eager, DeepSymm `mxfp4` | 507.6 s |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+import math
+import sys
+from functools import lru_cache
+from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen import envs
+
+DEEPSYMM_DIST_NAME = "deep-symm"
+DEEPSYMM_PACKAGE = "applications.ai.gpu.deepsymm"
+DEEPSYMM_RING_PRECISIONS = ("bf16", "fp8", "fp8_mixed", "mxfp4")
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def _import_ring_attn_ipc_forward():
+    try:
+        deepsymm_version = version(DEEPSYMM_DIST_NAME)
+    except PackageNotFoundError as e:
+        raise ImportError(
+            f"XPU DeepSymm ring attention requires package {DEEPSYMM_PACKAGE!r} "
+            f"(distribution {DEEPSYMM_DIST_NAME!r}), which is not installed; "
+            "build it from source into the same environment as SGLang."
+        ) from e
+    try:
+        from deep_symm.ring_attn import ring_attn_ipc_forward
+    except (ImportError, OSError) as e:
+        raise ImportError(
+            f"Package {DEEPSYMM_PACKAGE!r} ({DEEPSYMM_DIST_NAME} {deepsymm_version}) "
+            f"is installed but deep_symm.ring_attn failed to load: {e!r}."
+        ) from e
+    return ring_attn_ipc_forward
+
+
+@torch.compiler.disable
+def deepsymm_ring_precision(
+    query: torch.Tensor, attn_impl, *, causal: bool, is_cross_attention: bool
+) -> str | None:
+    precision = envs.SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_DEEPSYMM_RING_PRECISION.strip().lower()
+    if precision == "off":
+        return None
+    if precision not in DEEPSYMM_RING_PRECISIONS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_DEEPSYMM_RING_PRECISION must be 'off' or one of "
+            f"{DEEPSYMM_RING_PRECISIONS}, got {precision!r}"
+        )
+    if query.device.type != "xpu" or query.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        return None
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.xpu_backend import (
+        XPUAttentionImpl,
+    )
+
+    if not isinstance(attn_impl, XPUAttentionImpl):
+        return None
+    head_size = attn_impl.head_size
+    if (
+        causal
+        or is_cross_attention
+        or head_size not in (64, 128)
+        or not math.isclose(attn_impl.softmax_scale, head_size**-0.5, rel_tol=1e-6)
+    ):
+        return None
+    num_kv_heads = attn_impl.num_kv_heads
+    if head_size != 128 or num_kv_heads not in (None, attn_impl.num_heads):
+        return "bf16"
+    return precision
+
+
+@torch.compiler.disable
+def deepsymm_ring_attn(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    key: torch.Tensor,
+    value: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    ring_group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup,
+    precision: str,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return _import_ring_attn_ipc_forward()(
+        process_group=ring_group,
+        q=query.contiguous(),
+        k=key.contiguous(),
+        v=value.contiguous(),
+        return_softmax_lse=False,
+        precision=precision,
+    )
+
+
+def clear_deepsymm_ring_cache() -> None:
+    if "deep_symm.ring_attn" not in sys.modules:
+        return
+    from deep_symm.ring_attn import ring_attn_ipc_clear_cache
+
+    ring_attn_ipc_clear_cache()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+
+HEAD_SIZE = 128
+PRECISION_ENV = "SGLANG_DIFFUSION_XPU_DEEPSYMM_RING_PRECISION"
+_MAX_REL_L2 = {"bf16": 0.02, "fp8": 0.1, "fp8_mixed": 0.3, "mxfp4": 0.4}
+
+
+def _xpu_count():
+    return torch.xpu.device_count() if torch.xpu.is_available() else 0
+
+
+def _impl(*, num_kv_heads=40, head_size=HEAD_SIZE, causal=False):
+    pytest.importorskip("sgl_kernel.flash_attn", reason="needs sgl-kernel-xpu")
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.xpu_backend import (
+        XPUAttentionImpl,
+    )
+
+    return XPUAttentionImpl(
+        num_heads=40,
+        head_size=head_size,
+        causal=causal,
+        softmax_scale=head_size**-0.5,
+        num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
+    )
+
+
+def _precision(query, impl, *, causal=False, is_cross_attention=False):
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.xpu_deepsymm_ring import (
+        deepsymm_ring_precision,
+    )
+
+    return deepsymm_ring_precision(
+        query, impl, causal=causal, is_cross_attention=is_cross_attention
+    )
+
+
+def test_off_by_default(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv(PRECISION_ENV, raising=False)
+    q = torch.empty(1, 8, 40, HEAD_SIZE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    assert _precision(q, object()) is None
+
+
+def test_unknown_precision_raises(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv(PRECISION_ENV, "int8")
+    q = torch.empty(1, 8, 40, HEAD_SIZE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=PRECISION_ENV):
+        _precision(q, object())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "impl_kwargs, call_kwargs, device, dtype, expected",
+    [
+        ({}, {}, "xpu", torch.bfloat16, "mxfp4"),
+        ({"num_kv_heads": 8}, {}, "xpu", torch.bfloat16, "bf16"),
+        ({"head_size": 64}, {}, "xpu", torch.bfloat16, "bf16"),
+        ({"head_size": 96}, {}, "xpu", torch.bfloat16, None),
+        ({}, {"causal": True}, "xpu", torch.bfloat16, None),
+        ({}, {"is_cross_attention": True}, "xpu", torch.bfloat16, None),
+        ({}, {}, "xpu", torch.float16, None),
+        ({}, {}, "cpu", torch.bfloat16, None),
+    ],
+)
+def test_precision_rules(
+    monkeypatch, impl_kwargs, call_kwargs, device, dtype, expected
+):
+    if _xpu_count() < 1:
+        pytest.skip("needs an XPU")
+    monkeypatch.setenv(PRECISION_ENV, "mxfp4")
+    impl = _impl(**impl_kwargs)
+    q = torch.empty(1, 8, 40, impl.head_size, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+    assert _precision(q, impl, **call_kwargs) == expected
+
+
+def _reference(q, k, v):
+    q, k, v = (t.float().transpose(1, 2) for t in (q, k, v))
+    return torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _ring_worker(rank, world_size, port, seq_per_rank, num_heads):
+    os.environ.update(
+        MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1",
+        MASTER_PORT=str(port),
+        RANK=str(rank),
+        LOCAL_RANK=str(rank),
+        WORLD_SIZE=str(world_size),
+    )
+    torch.xpu.set_device(rank)
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed.parallel_state import (
+        destroy_model_parallel,
+        get_sp_group,
+        maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel,
+    )
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.xpu_deepsymm_ring import (
+        deepsymm_ring_attn,
+    )
+
+    maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel(
+        tp_size=1, sp_size=world_size, ring_degree=world_size
+    )
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
+    shape = (1, seq_per_rank * world_size, num_heads, HEAD_SIZE)
+    q, k, v = (torch.randn(shape, generator=generator).bfloat16() for _ in range(3))
+    local = slice(rank * seq_per_rank, (rank + 1) * seq_per_rank)
+    expected = _reference(q[:, local], k, v)
+    device = torch.device("xpu", rank)
+    for precision, max_rel_l2 in _MAX_REL_L2.items():
+        for _ in range(2):
+            out = deepsymm_ring_attn(
+                q[:, local].to(device),
+                k[:, local].to(device),
+                v[:, local].to(device),
+                ring_group=get_sp_group().ring_group,
+                precision=precision,
+            )
+        assert out.shape == expected.shape and out.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        rel_l2 = ((out.cpu().float() - expected).norm() / expected.norm()).item()
+        print(f"rank {rank} {precision}: rel_l2 {rel_l2:.4f}", flush=True)
+        assert rel_l2 < max_rel_l2, (precision, rel_l2)
+    destroy_model_parallel()
+    torch.distributed.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("seq_per_rank, num_heads", [(2048, 8), (4725, 40)])
+def test_two_rank_ring_matches_full_attention(seq_per_rank, num_heads):
+    if _xpu_count() < 2:
+        pytest.skip("needs two XPUs")
+    pytest.importorskip("deep_symm.ring_attn", reason="needs deep_symm")
+    from sglang.srt.utils.network import get_free_port_below_ephemeral
+
+    mp.spawn(
+        _ring_worker,
+        args=(2, get_free_port_below_ephemeral(), seq_per_rank, num_heads),
+        nprocs=2,
+    )
